_schema: preservation-loan-book class scoring v1.0 (public-agency asset management). Shape follows references/pipeline-contract.md Section 11: v2's factor/band/modifier/match grammar plus factor-level `requires`, band option `basis_from: governing_event`, and the DSL ops `absent` and `contains`. `lever` is renamed `intervention` (the tool the agency can deploy); `reading` is how the agency asset manager experiences the signal. Multipliers, queue bands, caps, decay and route precedence live in shared_adjustments.json and are never restated here. Weights sum to 100. Every band carries id, event_type or signal, match, points, reading, intervention. A factor with empty evidence scores 0.

units_at_risk_rule.description: Units are counted once, in plb/units.py, and read by this table through the lead columns units_at_risk, hap_units_at_risk, prac_units_at_risk, other_ra_units, psh_units_at_risk. They never multiply the 0-100 score; board_impact = units_at_risk x timing_fraction(owner_cliff_band) is a separate sort key and the Board_Totals input.
units_at_risk_rule.restricted_units: Total Units - Market_Rate_Units (blank market = 0, units_basis total_assumed_restricted); AMI buckets that sum to Total Units set units_basis reported_buckets; buckets are otherwise descriptive only; Total Units blank -> units blank + 'Missing Source — Request Document'.
units_at_risk_rule.units_at_risk: restricted_units when the governing owner-cliff event's program covers the whole property (LIHTC extended use, HAP, HUD/USDA); the program's units_assisted from the servicing extract for SOFT_PROGRAM_END / AFFORDABILITY_PERIOD_END when matched, else restricted_units with units_basis proxy.
units_at_risk_rule.hap_units_at_risk: Rental_Assistance_Count only when HUD Contract is Housing Assistance Payment (program HAP) or RAC; PRAC/PAC -> prac_units_at_risk; otherwise other_ra_units. The three are never summed into one figure.
units_at_risk_rule.psh_units_at_risk: PSH_Units overlay; not additive to restricted_units.
units_at_risk_rule.window: Factor units_households_at_risk scores only when the governing owner-cliff event is within -12..60 months (OVERDUE through MONITOR). Beyond 60 months the units still appear in Board_Totals and Units_by_Year at 0 points.

factors.name: units_households_at_risk

bands.reading: Under five restricted homes: outside PuSH (ORS 456.250 covers 5+ units) but still households whose protection ends inside the window.
bands.intervention: board_packet_summary; covenant_recapture_review when a HOME/CDBG period is the cliff

bands.reading: A small building whose restrictions end inside five years; one lost HAP contract here is a whole building of households.
Mid-size restricted stock with a dated cliff; the scale a single NOFA award or 0% recap can carry.
Fifty to ninety-nine restricted homes with a dated cliff: a board-visible loss if nothing is done.
One hundred or more restricted homes with protection ending inside five years; boards count units, and this is the line they read first.
bands.intervention: board_packet_summary; preservation_nofa_invitation; designee appointment where PuSH applies

modifiers.reading: Permanent supportive housing units are the hardest households to re-house; losing them lands on the county's homelessness system.
Elderly or disabled property type: residents with the least ability to absorb displacement; 202/811 and PRAC stock concentrates here.
A quarter or more of the units are three bedrooms or larger: family housing that the market does not replace at restricted rents.
modifiers.intervention: preservation_nofa_invitation (family set-aside where the mandate has one)

modifiers.reading: Half or more of the restricted units carry project-based assistance: deep subsidy that leaves with the contract, not with the rent limit.

factors.notes: Attribute factor whose basis multiplier is borrowed from the governing owner-cliff event (basis_from governing_event): 120 units at risk on a REPORTED LIHTC extended-use end at 30 months scores 25 x 0.90; the same units at 90 months score 0 because `requires` fails. units_basis is a flag, not a second multiplier. Cap 25 after modifiers; nothing here subtracts.

factors.name: restriction_hap_qc_clock

bands.reading: Year 30 cliff inside three years: the extended-use agreement ends and the PuSH first-notice window is open or past; the agency's tools are the notice audit, the designee appointment and a recap award.
bands.intervention: push_window_prep -> push_notice_demand_letter when due passes; preservation_nofa_invitation; rofr_notice_recording

bands.reading: Extended use ends inside the five-year preservation planning horizon; the award cohort that lands 12-24 months before the cliff must be chosen now.

Year 15 is a decision point for any owner: the LP exits, a nonprofit GP may exercise its 42(i)(7) ROFR, a for-profit GP may seek a qualified contract or a sale. The agency scores the decision point, not the owner's politics.
bands.intervention: ta_sponsor_engagement (mission GP); qc_request_acknowledgement if a QC request arrives; rofr_notice_recording where PuSH applies

bands.reading: Two or more years past Year 15 with no transfer: the LP interest may have traded to an aggregator while the extended-use agreement still runs.
bands.intervention: ta_sponsor_engagement; push_records_request once a notice is on file; ask who holds the LP interest

bands.reading: Section 8 contract expires inside 24 months: a renewal-or-opt-out decision the contract administrator reviews; the one-year tenant/CA notice (24 CFR 402.8) and the 120-day opt-out package are the agency's clocks.
The recorded HAP expiration is in the past with no termination evidence: an annual renewal most likely rolled and the source is stale, not a lost contract.
bands.intervention: optout_tenant_notice_check (confirm the current contract and TRACS expiration at the CA); request the current HAP contract

bands.reading: Section 8 contract runs out inside the planning horizon; under annual renewal the date will roll, under a multi-year term it is the decision point.
bands.intervention: optout_response_plan (early); confirm renewal option at the CA

bands.reading: 202/811 PRAC or PAC renewal inside 24 months: the risk is appropriation and sponsor capacity, not an owner opt-out (Notice H 2022-05 five-year renewals; verify).
236 / 221(d)(3) / 202 maturity inside three years ends the use agreement unless decoupled, refinanced with a new use agreement, or prepaid under HUD notice.
bands.intervention: hud_legacy_response (Notice H 2013-25 decoupling, H 2013-17 202 prepayment); loan_extension_recast_memo when in book

bands.reading: Section 515 maturity inside three years ends interest credit and the RA tie; the public body can be the purchaser or the MPR partner.
The borrower may file a prepayment request under 7 CFR 3560 subpart N; once filed, RD's tenant notice and the 180-day nonprofit/public-body offer window run.
bands.intervention: usda_prepay_response (ask RD for the request status)

bands.reading: A prepayment request is on file with RD: the public-body offer window (7 CFR 3560.659, verify) is the agency's purchase right.
bands.intervention: usda_prepay_response; rofr_assignment_memo if a mission sponsor should take the offer

bands.reading: A HOME / CDBG / local affordability period ends inside three years: the covenant we recorded falls away unless re-invested or extended.
A local regulatory agreement ends inside three years.
bands.intervention: loan_extension_recast_memo (extend the covenant with the note); preservation_nofa_invitation

bands.reading: A state soft-program affordability period (OAHTC, GHAP, HDGP, LIFT, HTF, HOME per OHCS) ends inside three years; rent limits on those units lift.
bands.intervention: covenant_recapture_review; stack with other ends (see stacking factor)

bands.reading: Soft-program period ends inside the planning horizon.
bands.intervention: monitor; align with the award cohort

bands.reading: The last known restriction on the property ends inside three years (OHCS LATEST or its recompute).
bands.intervention: push_window_prep (confirm which agreement is last from our own file)

modifiers.reading: A 20-year MAHRA renewal was just executed: the owner is staying in the program.
Annual or short renewals keep the owner's options open every year; the CA sees a renewal request or an opt-out notice each cycle.

The anchor-minus-30-month date (the ORS 456.262 designee-appointment trigger, verify) falls inside the next six months or passed within the last month and no owner notice is on file: the agency's clock is about to start. Bounded so a long-passed date is not counted twice with first_notice_due_passed_unknown.
modifiers.intervention: push_window_prep now; push_notice_demand_letter when the due date passes with not_received_confirmed

modifiers.reading: The HFA's one-year qualified-contract period (IRC 42(h)(6)(I), verify) ends inside twelve months.
modifiers.intervention: qc_marketing_plan; present a bona fide contract before the period ends

modifiers.reading: The 120-day opt-out package date (Renewal Guide ch. 11, verify) falls inside six months: the CA will know the owner's intent by then.

factors.notes: Take max of bands, add modifiers, cap 20, then the governing-event basis multiplier. HAP_EXPIRATION carries confidence 0.70 (annual / unknown term) or 0.90 (20-year MAHRA; PBV from the agency's own contract file) and the engine multiplies that band's points by the confidence. PRAC/PAC rows score through prac_le_24 only and never through hap_le_24. A STALE_CONTRACT_DATE row scores through hap_stale_le_12_past only. Modifiers that name AGENCY_DEADLINE types match events.csv rows (helpers are in events.csv, outside the basis counts and events_in_horizon). recap_status under_application/closed with RECORDED/REPORTED evidence halves this factor (shared_adjustments.multipliers.recap_status). LIFT or 60-year REUA ends beyond 120 months are BEYOND and never match a band.

factors.name: declared_intent_vs_silence

bands.reading: The owner has told OHCS and the affected local government the restrictions will end: the records right, the designee appointment and the recorded ROFR are now live.
Second owner notice on file: withdrawal is no sooner than 24 months out; the match right and the tenant-notice check run from here.
Section 8 opt-out notice on file with the CA / HUD: the one-year clock is running and enhanced vouchers follow unless the contract is kept through a transfer.
bands.intervention: optout_response_plan; optout_tenant_notice_check (defective notice restarts the clock)

bands.reading: The owner has mailed a third-party offer to the ROFR holders: the 30-day match clock runs from the certified mailing (ORS 456.263, verify).

Working label (ORS 456.260/.262 unread): the anchor-minus-30-month date passed and the agency's own log confirms no notice: silence inside a statutory window is a compliance case, and withdrawal cannot occur until the clocks run from a proper notice.
bands.intervention: push_notice_demand_letter; designee appointment on silence (ORS 456.262 as amended by HB 2095, verify); tenant_notice_check

bands.reading: No qualified contract was presented inside the one-year period: extended use has ended and the three-year tenant protection (IRC 42(h)(6)(E)(ii)) is the only restriction left.
bands.intervention: qc_marketing_plan (last-chance preservation award); tenant protection monitoring

bands.reading: A qualified-contract request is on the HFA's log: the one-year period to present a bona fide contract is running; presentment alone removes the exit.
The 515 borrower has filed a prepayment request: RD tenant notice and the public-body offer window are running.
The first-notice due date has passed and the agency has not confirmed whether a notice was received: absence in our data is not owner silence until the PuSH-CP log says so.
bands.intervention: push_window_prep first_action: confirm against the PuSH-CP log / ask OHCS; counted in Data Gaps

bands.reading: Our right (or a designee's) is recorded against the title: any third-party sale must be offered to us first.

factors.notes: Inside the first-notice window (anchor -36..-30 months) the owner is not late: this factor scores 0, the lead carries signal push_window_open_prep and a PUSH_WINDOW_PREP calendar row, and notice_compliance is a secondary route only. The 6-point band fires only on notice_status unknown after the due date; not_received_confirmed after the due date is expressed as the NOTICE_COMPLIANCE_BREACH event (emitted by plb/agency_calendar.py) and scores 15. The signal band first_notice_due_passed_unknown matches closed_second_due as well because the first due date has necessarily passed. QC bands require RECORDED basis (agency log or read REUA); an `eligible` status computed from allocation vintage alone never scores here.

factors.name: our_capital_at_risk

bands.reading: Our loan or regulatory agreement is in default on our own books: public dollars and the covenant are both at risk now.
A sale, payoff or foreclosure inside the affordability period has triggered recapture (24 CFR 92.254 / 92.503 / 570.505, verify).
Our note matures inside three years: a balloon the restricted NOI may not carry, and a decision point we control.
Our note matures inside the five-year window; start the recast conversation 18 months out.
Our note matures inside the ten-year list.
The affordability period on our own HOME / CDBG / local award ends inside three years (RECORDED from our ledger).
bands.intervention: covenant_recapture_review; preservation_nofa_invitation (re-invest for a new period)

bands.reading: Our grant's recapture period ends inside three years: the last window in which a sale returns public dollars.
Our shared-appreciation note comes due inside three years.
Our asset manager has the loan on watch (covenant_status watch).
Our own asset (PHA-owned) has a restriction, contract or debt cliff inside three years.

modifiers.reading: A senior HUD / agency / bank maturity or HAP expiration lands within 24 months of our maturity: a stacked balloon the recast must solve together.
modifiers.intervention: loan_extension_recast_memo (resubordination with the senior refinance); sizing-lihtc-permanent-debt handoff

factors.notes: Factor-scoped, never lead-scoped: book_match unmatched_expected scores 0 with factor status WATCH, flag 'Verify — Book Join' and a Book_Join_Gaps row, and the lead's queue_band is not capped; not_in_extract / not_in_book / book_absent make the factor n/a with no flag. A balance is never guessed. Dollars at risk (public_upb_at_risk, public_grant_at_risk) are columns computed in plb/units.py, not points.

factors.name: physical_reac_occupancy

bands.reading: Score 30 or below: automatic referral to HUD's Departmental Enforcement Center (pre-NSPIRE procedure; verify); troubled-asset management with HUD at the table.
bands.intervention: covenant_enforcement_notice; enforcement_8823 where LIHTC; recap_committee workout

bands.reading: Failing inspection: blocks Mark-Up-To-Market renewal and signals a capital-needs backlog the agency may have to fund.
Passing but marginal, or a 15-point decline: deferred maintenance is accumulating.
An open compliance finding or a filed Form 8823 on our monitoring file.
On the city's dangerous-building list: life-safety exposure for assisted households.
A regulated property on the county tax-foreclosure list: the covenant can be extinguished by a tax deed.
Occupancy under 85% or down 10 points: management or condition problem on an assisted asset.
The low-income property-tax exemption dropped off the roll: an ownership change or a compliance lapse we did not see.
bands.intervention: covenant_enforcement_notice; confirm ownership (2530 / TPA where HUD)

bands.reading: Two or more years of unpaid property tax on a regulated asset.
One year of unpaid property tax.
bands.intervention: servicing_watch; ask about the operating deficit

bands.reading: Open code-enforcement case.
A construction or judgment lien has been recorded against a regulated asset.
Management agent changed.

modifiers.reading: Rehabilitated within the last five years: physical risk is lower.

factors.notes: Same events as the buyer rubric, read as troubled-asset asset management rather than a bid discount. recent_rehab (build_context: rehab_year >= as_of_year - 5) lives only here; shared_adjustments has no penalties block. REAC_SCORE from the agency's own file is RECORDED; from the HUD export REPORTED. NSPIRE and legacy UPCS scores are not comparable (detail=protocol).

factors.name: sponsor_capacity

bands.reading: Nonprofit, PHA or government sponsor: a partner with the standing to exercise a 42(i)(7) ROFR or recapitalize, and the natural recipient of TA and a NOFA invitation.
Our own asset: capacity to act is ours; the levers are repositioning and recapitalization.
For-profit or Limited Dividend GP at Year 15: the owner with the most reasons and the fewest obligations to exit; preservation risk, not a buy-side signal.
bands.intervention: push_window_prep; rofr_notice_recording where PuSH applies; qc_request_acknowledgement if a QC request arrives

bands.reading: The LP interest traded to an aggregator or the GP / manager changed: the Year-15 exit may be contested or accelerated and the nonprofit ROFR challenged.
bands.intervention: push_notice_demand_letter readiness; rofr_notice_recording; lihtc-lpa-reviewer handoff (2C); aggregator certification in the QAP

bands.reading: The owning entity is administratively dissolved on the SOS registry: a sponsor-capacity failure and a notice-address problem.
bands.intervention: covenant_enforcement_notice; confirm notice_address; ta_sponsor_engagement if mission GP

bands.reading: HUD 2530 / APPS flag on a controlling participant (24 CFR 200 subpart H, verify): HUD has recorded prior noncompliance.
bands.intervention: servicing_watch; request 2530 status from HUD before any recap

bands.reading: A RAD CHAP or Section 18 application is in progress on our own asset: repositioning under way, new HAP/PBV events follow.

modifiers.reading: Out-of-state for-profit sponsor: less tied to local preservation politics (from the servicing extract or SOS worklist only; never automated).
modifiers.intervention: push_window_prep; preservation_nofa_invitation to a local mission sponsor

modifiers.reading: The same sponsor faces two or more cliffs inside 36 months across the universe: capacity is constrained (mission) or the exit is portfolio-wide (for-profit).
modifiers.intervention: ta_sponsor_engagement (portfolio recap) or portfolio notice audit; Sponsor_Exposure tab

modifiers.reading: Registered agent changed: re-confirm the notice address before any letter.

factors.notes: Both directions add points and nothing subtracts (floor 0): mission sponsors are high-priority partners (TA / NOFA), aggregator or for-profit Year-15 posture is preservation risk (notice audit / ROFR). owner_type unknown scores 0, carries signal owner_type_unknown and goes on the SOS worklist; the brief states the unknown share (443 of 810 OHCS metro rows have a blank Owner Type). No housing-authority cap, no 'not for sale' reading.

factors.name: stacking_geography_equity

bands.reading: Two restrictions end within the same 24 months.
Three or more restrictions end together: the property must transact or be recapitalized.
HAP and extended-use cliffs coincide: the classic preservation trigger.

modifiers.reading: In a high-displacement-risk tract per the pack's equity overlay.
In a district under-served by prior awards per the pack's equity overlay.

factors.notes: programs_ending_same_24mo counts REGULATORY-family PRESSURE events whose dates fall within a rolling 24-month window, excluding NOTICE_COMPLIANCE_BREACH and every helper type. Equity overlays come from references/sources/<pack>/equity_overlays.yaml and score 0 when the file is absent; the Assumptions tab says so.

hard_filters.effect: queue_band EXCLUDED; exclusion_reason in_development; listed in brief 'Pipeline, not scored' pointing to map-progress-monitor / map-troubled-project-escalator

hard_filters.condition: no geo_mode of the run matches
units < 5 AND no REGULATORY or DEBT PRESSURE event inside horizon
no dated PRESSURE event (owner-side REGULATORY/DEBT, OPERATING, TAX_LIEN, PHYSICAL) inside horizon_years
hard_filters.effect: queue_band EXCLUDED; exclusion_reason no_dated_cliff_in_horizon; property still counted in Board_Totals 'beyond horizon' / 'no dated cliff' rows
route nofa_offer blocked; mandate_ineligible_reason recorded; the lead still scores and routes elsewhere. Never an exclusion reason and never a multiplier.

profile_gates.notice_compliance: profile.receives_push_notice or profile.is_qualified_purchaser (cdbg_home: INSPECTION_DUE / recapture review in place of PuSH enforcement)

rules.condition: program in {HAP, RAC, PBV} (never PRAC/PAC) AND PRESERVATION_NOTICE_RECEIVED detail hap_optout
program in {HAP, RAC, PBV} AND hap_renewal_request_status == not_received AND HAP_EXPIRATION <= 120 days
program in {HAP, RAC, PBV} AND HAP_EXPIRATION months_out in [0, 12] AND status != STALE_CONTRACT_DATE AND detail != mahra_20yr_recent AND hap_renewal_request_status == unknown
rules.first_action: confirm renewal request / opt-out notice at CA

rules.effect: no optout route; signal optout_window_closed_for_term (protective); agency act-by = next_expected_expiration - 12 mo with first_action 'confirm renewal at CA'; kpi hap_renewed

rules.condition: notice_window_state in {closed_first_due, closed_second_due} AND notice_status != received
rules.intervention: push_notice_demand_letter when not_received_confirmed; push_window_prep (confirm log) when unknown

rules.condition: tenant_notice_status == not_confirmed inside or after TENANT_NOTICE_WINDOW (SB 973 operative per pack date; verify)

rules.note: secondary only; the owner is not late inside the window; never from QC signals

rules.condition: QC_ELIGIBILITY status in {requested, lapsed_decontrol} AND basis RECORDED AND qc_waived != true AND profile.administers_qc

rules.note: ta_sponsor when a mission sponsor is available, else nofa_offer; never notice_compliance

rules.condition: ROFR_RECORDED OR THIRD_PARTY_OFFER_RECEIVED OR (PRESERVATION_NOTICE_RECEIVED detail in {push_first, push_second} AND (profile.is_qualified_purchaser OR profile.is_designee)) OR USDA_PREPAY_REQUEST_RECEIVED OR (NOTICE_COMPLIANCE_BREACH AND profile.is_qualified_purchaser)

universe == our_book AND (intervention_score >= 50 OR COVENANT_DEFAULT OR RECAPTURE_TRIGGER OR REAC_SCORE value < 60 OR RECEIVER_APPOINTED OR BANKRUPTCY_FILED OR JUDICIAL_FORECLOSURE_FILED OR AGENCY_LOAN_MATURITY <= 24 mo OR coterminous_senior_cliff OR (self_owned AND (RAD_CHAP OR SECTION_18_APPLICATION OR owner_cliff_months_out <= 24)))

universe == our_book AND (any AGENCY_LOAN_MATURITY / AFFORDABILITY_PERIOD_END (ours) / GRANT_RECAPTURE_END / SHARED_APPRECIATION_DUE <= 60 mo OR covenant_status in {watch, default} OR REAC_SCORE value < 60 OR NONCOMPLIANCE_FINDING open OR INSPECTION_DUE <= 6 mo OR senior cliff <= 60 mo)
rules.note: a healthy book loan with none of these is primary_route none (Book_Watchlist, AM status Monitoring)

rules.condition: (universe == universe_not_held OR (universe == our_book AND recap_status in {announced, under_application})) AND REGULATORY/DEBT owner cliff <= 60 mo AND mandate_fit in {eligible, no_mandate_file}

owner_type in {nonprofit, lihtc_partnership_nonprofit_gp, housing_authority, government} AND NOT self_owned AND (LIHTC_COMPLIANCE_END OR LIHTC_EXTENDED_USE_END OR ROFR_RECORDED OR QC signal (non-hfa)) <= 60 mo

routes.primary_rule: Evaluate every rule; primary_route = the matched route earliest in `precedence`, filtered by the profile gate and self_owned_skips; every other matched route goes to secondary_routes. A scored lead with has_pressure_in_horizon and no rule hit is primary_route none. next_action = the primary intervention's first_action + agency_action_date.

quality_rules: A/B/C never appear in any output; queue_band ESCALATE / ACT / PLAN / WATCH / EXCLUDED only.
Proxy-only governing events -> queue cap PLAN (shared_adjustments.caps.proxy_only).
No dated PRESSURE event inside horizon -> EXCLUDED no_dated_cliff_in_horizon, still counted in Board_Totals.

SOFT_PROGRAM_END / AFFORDABILITY_PERIOD_END are affordability-period ends, not note maturities; a soft-loan balloon scores only as AGENCY_LOAN_MATURITY (ours, RECORDED) or SOFT_LOAN_MATURITY (recorded).
HAP expiration dates under annual renewal roll forward each year; a past HUD date with no termination evidence is STALE_CONTRACT_DATE, never OVERDUE in Board_Totals and never `lost`.

PuSH windows and PUSH_*_DUE anchor on withdrawal_anchor_date (restriction-type ends; HAP/PRAC only with a non-renewal signal); a HAP-only property with an annual date eight months out emits no PuSH window and no breach.

No demand or records letter is generated before the statutory trigger it cites (records request follows the owner's notice by 10 days; demand letter follows PUSH_FIRST_NOTICE_DUE with not_received_confirmed).
qc_admin fires only on a RECORDED QC request with qc_waived != true and only when the profile administers QC.
Mandate eligibility is a route-level hard filter on nofa_offer; never an exclusion, never a multiplier.
recap_status under_application/closed with RECORDED/REPORTED evidence halves restriction_hap_qc_clock and declared_intent_vs_silence only.
Nothing in sponsor_capacity subtracts; no owner type is capped or routed as a non-event.
Default outputs are organization level (am_officer included, no contact detail); no owner phone or personal email anywhere.
